en: Distinguishes costs of mere form-change from preservation and transport costs tied to production
Distinguishes fixed and circulating capital by how value is transferred to the product and how fast it turns over
Explains how turnover time and number of turnovers shape annual surplus-value from a given capital
Analyzes circulation time as non-productive time that nevertheless limits turnover and the speed of valorization
